name: Can you add a home extension on a small lot in North Hollywood or Burbank?

mainEntity.name: Can you add a home extension on a small lot in North Hollywood or Burbank?
mainEntity.text: Can you add a home extension on a small lot in North Hollywood or Burbank?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small lots can still support meaningful home extensions, but the design has to work around local setback rules, lot coverage limits, utility easements, and outdoor space requirements. In neighborhoods like North Hollywood and Burbank, a compact rear addition or partial second-story expansion may be more practical than trying to spread out horizontally. The right solution depends on the shape of the lot, where the existing house sits, and how much open yard must remain. A smart design can sometimes make a small lot feel much larger without consuming every available inch. Before committing to a concept, the property should be measured carefully and checked against zoning and code constraints. If the lot is tight, an experienced design-build team can often identify opportunities that a generic plan would miss.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but small lots limit what you can build because setbacks, lot coverage, and yard requirements reduce the available footprint. In many cases, the best options are a compact rear addition, partial second story, or reconfiguration of the existing interior.
